verb: paws the ground, charges and tosses with its horn
_assumptions: ASSUMPTION (the PRDs are silent on the woolly rhino): a tundra horned_charger between the megaloceros (tier 30) and the smilodon (45); stats between the megaloceros and the styracosaurus; tamed as a cargo mount (bag + mount + combat like the other horned chargers); real_length_m 7.4 = the roster's 2x of a 3.7 m animal; height 2.95 m = ~1.8 m at the hump x1.6 house exaggeration.
look: woolly rhinoceros standing 2.9 meters at the shoulder hump, barrel body under a thick dark grey-brown curly coat, a long pale curved nose horn and a short second horn, short thick legs, small ears, a tufted tail
texture_prompt: dark grey-brown curly wool, darker legs and face, pale bone-coloured horns, matte surface

clips.big_stomp: BIGSTOMP: shared big-dinosaur stomp, the near foot hauled high, held, then slammed down under the body (impact 0.72); a direct hit pins (pin_foot)
clips.pin_foot: BIGSTOMP: the stomping foot pressed down on a pinned victim, held until the pin ends
clips.alert: Woolly rhino drops its head, snorts and paws the ground three times with a forefoot: the telegraph before its charge
clips.charge: Head-down gallop with the nose horn levelled forward
clips.toss: At the charge's impact the head whips up and to the side, hooking the horn up through the target
clips.attack_primary: Forefoot stamp: the forequarters rise, then both forefeet slam down a stride ahead
clips.attack_heavy: Wide horn sweep: head cocked far right and held (the tell), then ripped across the front to the far left
clips.knockdown: Forelegs buckle and it rolls onto its right side
clips.sleep: Lies down on its belly with the legs folded and the chin low

tactics._about: ASSUMPTION (SP-WOOLLY_RHINO): the horned_charger brain (display -> charge, point-blank heavy, basic) with the rhino's moves: display = the paw-the-ground alert clip, a longer charge that tosses (the toss clip on impact, the survivor shoved charge_shove_m and lifted toss_lift_mps), attack_heavy = the wide horn sweep, the basic = the forefoot stamp. No hind kick (no kick clip).

pipeline.inputs: ref/woolly_rhino_tripo_{front,left,back,right}.png: cropped from the owner's sheet (woolly_rhino_owner_sheet_1), padded to one scale; right = left mirrored
pipeline.variant_note: alpha = the owner's alpha sheet (woolly_rhino_owner_sheet_2_alpha: reddish, shaggy) as a recolour of the Tripo albedo on the same UVs (tools/gait/woolly_rhino/alpha_skin.py); only alpha spawns wear it.

hit_parts._about: Where each move hits (the hitbox system is not on canon yet): at the clip's hit frame the named bones must be within radius_m of the target's body (Creature._part_hit). HornTip/Horn: the nose horn; FrontFoot.*: the forefeet.
